profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is listed as a public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, trading under the ticker DXC, with SEC CIK 0001688568. The website associated with the company in the source material is dexus.com, and the text harvested from that site describes a different business: Dexus (ASX: DXS), an Australasian infrastructure and real estate fund manager that describes four decades of expertise in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development. The site text does not describe DXC Technology's own operations.

As described on that site, Dexus points to Australia being home to what it calls the world's tallest hybrid timber tower, with Atlassian Central reaching full height of more than 180 metres in Sydney, and to a redundant Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds through an adaptive reuse strategy. The company describes combining local insight with world class expertise and refers to the strength and scale of a multi-billion dollar portfolio. It also states that the information on the site is general only, is subject to change without notice, and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

The facts held about DXC Technology Co include no tracked AI products and no MCP servers. No lawsuits are listed for the company, and its law exposure is recorded in Virginia with a count of 133.
